remarks: STAMFORD at its best! Desirable location and a spacious, open, light and bright 1BD condominium in the heart of Glenbrook. With beautifully maintained and professionally landscaped grounds, dedicated parking spot and large storage room, this property should not be missed. Spacious kitchen flows right in to a large open dining/living room combo with custom built-ins and windows bringing in an incredible amount of natural light. Great size bedroom is very private and offers great amount of closet space. Hardwood floors throughout, HEAT AND HOT WATER INCLUDED in rent, laundry on premises. Walk to Downtown Stamford's shops and restaurants, minutes to beaches, parks, tennis, basketball, library and all of Stamford's best features right at your fingerprints. Ready for Nov 15th occupancy.
